description: This file defines an interface for reading provisioning criteria within the provisioning service of Apache Fineract. It declares methods for retrieving provisioning criteria templates, specific criteria by ID, all criteria, and templates based on data.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to read provisioning criteria data in the Fineract provisioning module.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a specific provisioning criteria by its ID.

methods.name: retrievePrivisiongCriteriaTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a provisioning criteria template based on provided data.
